text: dsh-chat-trash 是面向 DSH Web 的会话删除插件，在侧边栏会话菜单中加入“Delete chat…”入口。确认后，它停止会话活动、清理会话的工作区归属与标记，并删除本机保存的会话日志和投影缓存，再刷新页面。适合需要从 DSH 中彻底移除会话记录的用户；删除没有撤销功能，插件通过 DSH_HOME 定位数据目录，未设置时使用默认目录。

dsh-chat-trash adds a “Delete chat…” action to DSH Web session menus. After confirmation, it stops session activity, clears workspace marks, deletes the local log and projection cache, then reloads the page. Deletion has no undo. Set DSH_HOME to select the data directory.
想把 DSH 侧边栏里不再需要的会话连同本机日志彻底删除。
DSH 能不能在会话菜单里提供一个确认后永久删除聊天的操作？
How can I permanently remove a DSH chat and its local session files from the sidebar?
dsh-chat-trash 的功能「永久删除会话」：在侧边栏会话菜单选择“Delete chat…”并确认后，停止该会话的活动，清理工作区、置顶和归档标记，再删除本机日志及投影缓存并刷新页面。

dsh-chat-trash README · chat-trash：> Permanently delete a chat from the DeepSeek Harness sidebar — no archive copy left behind.

Built by **[mars-area](https://github.com/mars-area)**.

One entry appears in a Session's `···` menu in the sidebar:

dsh-chat-trash README · chat-trash：- **Delete chat…** — confirms, then removes the chat: its running turn is stopped, its workspace membership, pin and archive marks are cleared, and its stored log and projection cache are deleted. The page reloads; the chat is gone from every view, not moved to the archive and not kept in a trash folder.

dsh-chat-trash README · chat-trash：The row is drawn with `MenuItemButton` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`, the same primitive the shipped Pin, Rename, Fork and Archive rows use, and carries the app's `IconTrashOutlineRegular` trash icon — so its type, weight, padding, icon size and hover treatment match the rest of the menu rather than imitating it.

dsh-chat-trash README · Install：1. In the Harness Web UI open **Plugins** in the sidebar.
2. **Add plugin → Install a third-party plugin**.
3. Enter the repository URL:

```
   https://github.com/mars-area/dsh-chat-trash
   ```

The short form `github:mars-area/dsh-chat-trash` works too.
4. Install, then switch the `chat-trash` bundle on if it is not on yet.
5. Open a chat's `···` menu in the sidebar: **Delete chat…** is the last row.

dsh-chat-trash README · Install：To work on the plugin, install your local checkout instead by entering its absolute
path (`C:\Users\<user>\projects\dsh-chat-trash`); toggle the bundle off and on
after editing `client.js` or `index.js`.

dsh-chat-trash README · What a delete does：1. Stops any running turn, job, subagent or scheduled reminder of that chat.
2. Takes the live Session out of the session store, so the sidebar stops listing it at once and persistence drains its last events and closes the log handle. Without this step a chat deleted only on disk lingered under *Ungrouped* until the next launch.
3. Clears the chat's pin, its workspace membership and any archive mark, so no row or archived copy survives anywhere.
4. Deletes `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<workspace>/<session-id>/` and its `<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_projcache` row.
5. Reloads the page, so the conversation pane cannot keep showing a chat whose log no longer exists.

dsh-chat-trash README · What a delete does：An open but idle chat is deletable. DSH keeps every chat you have opened live in memory for the run, so "is this chat open?" is not a usable test — the plugin does not make it.

dsh-chat-trash README · There is no undo：The log is deleted, not archived, so keep a copy first when it matters: use the
Session header's **Download session log** action or the `/export` command, which
writes a ZIP of the session, its sub-sessions and attachments.

dsh-chat-trash README · Limits：- DSH has no delete API by design, so this bundle edits the persistence directory behind the seam. A future Harness version may change the log layout or the `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` contract; the plugin then fails loudly (the button reports the error) or stops appearing, and should be updated.
- Deleting only affects this machine. Logs already uploaded by *Settings → General → Upload Session Log when using the official model API* cannot be reached from here.
- Turning the bundle off in Plugins removes the menu row; chats already deleted stay deleted.
dsh-chat-trash README · Credit：Made by **[mars-area](https://github.com/mars-area)**. Issues and patches belong there.

dsh-chat-trash README · Files：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host half: the delete route, work stop, membership cleanup, file removal |
| `client.js` | Browser half: the menu row, its icon and confirmation |
| `icon.png` | Bundle artwork shown on the Plugins page (256×256 PNG) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the plugin row into the profile |
| `test-host.mjs` | Smoke test of the host half against a throwaway `DSH_HOME` (not shipped) |
| `test-client.mjs` | Smoke test of the browser half against a stub module loader (not shipped) |
